meta.description: Use when building Next.js 14+ applications with App Router, server components, or server actions. Invoke to configure route handlers, implement middleware, set up API routes, add streaming SSR, write generateMetadata for SEO, scaffold loading.tsx/error.tsx boundaries, or deploy to Vercel. Triggers on: Next.js, Next.js 14, App Router, RSC, use server, Server Components, Server Actions, React Server Components, generateMetadata, loading.tsx, Next.js deployment, Vercel, Next.js performance.

howto.what: Claude 会按照 Next.js 14+ 的最佳实践来构建应用：使用 App Router、默认用服务端组件、用 generateMetadata 做 SEO、用 next/image 优化图片、在异步路由段添加 loading.tsx 和 error.tsx，并提供代码示例。
howto.when: 当你提到 Next.js、App Router、服务端组件、Server Actions 等关键词，或要求配置路由、实现中间件、部署到 Vercel 时触发。

say.text: 写一个服务端组件，从 API 获取产品列表并缓存 60 秒。
say.note: Claude 会提供带 ISR 的代码。

say.text: 为产品详情页添加动态 SEO 元数据。

howto.what_en: Claude will build applications following Next.js 14+ best practices: use App Router, default to Server Components, use generateMetadata for SEO, optimize images with next/image, add loading.tsx and error.tsx for async route segments, and provide code examples.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like Next.js, App Router, Server Components, Server Actions, or ask to configure routes, implement middleware, or deploy to Vercel.

say_en.text: Create a Next.js 14 App Router project with layout and loading state.
say_en.note: Claude will generate project structure and code.

say_en.text: Write a server component that fetches product list from API and caches for 60 seconds.
say_en.note: Claude will provide code with ISR.

say_en.text: Add dynamic SEO metadata for a product detail page.
